note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1952: nominations received by W. B. O'Donoghue, clerk, 20 May 1952; contests in Bessbrook North, Camlough and Moybane, polled 5 June 1952. No party labels printed. Polled 5 June 1952. Fearon was the sitting member. No labels printed; at the count James Maginnis said "the Labour Party would return to the fight".
